cause: Q1'24 revenue near top of guide but EPS ($0.18) missed midpoint on mix/warranty costs; the pop was driven by strong Q2 guidance (+$25M sequential revenue, gross margin back up to 45%) on HBM demand reaching nearly half of DRAM revenue - double H2'23 levels and much earlier than expected, plus advanced packaging (Foveros/3DFabric) test-intensity uplift
quality: 经营性持续但客户集中: HBM test/probe card demand is a genuine structural AI-memory tailwind (test complexity rising with stacking), but management flagged concentration in primarily one HBM customer and limited visibility into H2 2024
reason: The underlying driver (HBM stacking requiring materially more wafer test) is a real, durable AI-infrastructure derivative theme, and Q2 guidance shows a clean sequential re-acceleration in both revenue and margin. FCF was positive ($19.7M) with capex in line with full-year guide, no cash-flow stress. Main risk is that Q1 itself was a mixed print (EPS miss, margin decline) and the re-rating rests heavily on forward guidance plus one concentrated HBM customer with limited H2 visibility, so conviction is moderate rather than high.
red_flags: HBM需求主要集中于一个大客户,集中度风险高;管理层明确表示对2024下半年可见度有限;本季度实际EPS未达指引中值(毛利率环比下滑340bp)
